title: Customers counts update straight after a move
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure three of the customers on Net 15 are customer A, customer B and customer C.
  • Before you start, write down how many customers hold Net 15 (number A) and how many hold Net 20 (number B).
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the "Net 15" row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Click "Select None".
  4. Tick customer A.
  5. Tick customer B.
  6. Tick customer C.
  7. Choose "Net 20" in "Move To".
  8. Click "Move 3 Customers".
  9. Reload the page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The window shows "number A selected" (for example "7 selected").

Step 3:

  • The count reads "0 selected".

Step 4:

  • The count reads "1 selected".

Step 5:

  • The count reads "2 selected".

Step 6:

  • The count reads "3 selected".
  • The button reads "Move 3 Customers".

Step 7:

  • The dropdown shows Net 20.

Step 8:

  • The toast reads "3 customers moved to Net 20." and, without reloading, Net 15 reads number A − 3 (for example 4) and Net 20 reads number B + 3 (for example 5).

Step 9:

  • The counts are the same after the reload.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list), story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-R9: “On confirm, each ticked customer's credit term changes to the chosen term, the window closes, the page's Customers counts update, and a success toast shows "{n} customers moved to {term}." ("1 customer moved to {term}." for one).”
  • S4-R2: “The window shows, top to bottom: a "Search customers" box; "Select All" and "Select None" with "{n} selected" on the right; a scrolling list of every customer on the term, A to Z, each with a checkbox; a "Move To" dropdown; and the buttons "Cancel" and "Move {n} Customers" ("Move 1 Customer" when one is selected).”
  • S1-R12: “The Customers column shows how many customers hold the term, right aligned, showing 0 when none. The Counter Sale customer is never counted. A customer with a blank term is counted under COD. Names that differ only in capitals and spaces count toward the same term ("NET 30" counts as Net 30; see §6).”
